component.name: Kubecord
component.summary: Chat, talk and stream on Discord

description.p: Kubecord is a native client for Discord, written in Rust with GTK and libadwaita. It is not made by or affiliated with Discord.

ul.li: Voice and video calls, with screen sharing that includes audio
Text chat with images, videos, GIFs, emoji, stickers and embeds
Slash commands, buttons, menus and forms from apps and bots
A local log of deleted and edited messages
Export a range of messages as a picture or as text
Multiple accounts
Follows your system colors, or uses Discord's own look

description.p: Note: third-party clients are against Discord's Terms of Service and can, rarely, lead to an account being banned.

screenshot.caption: A server's channels, a chat and its members

ul.li: Polls: vote, see results, end your own and create them
Forward messages to up to five DMs or channels
Voice messages: play them with their waveform, and record your own
Discord's animated stickers, a sticker picker, and "Wave to say hi" on join messages
An inbox of recent mentions, filtered by server and notifications
Message requests: accept or ignore DMs from people you haven't accepted
Stage channels: speakers, audience, raising your hand, and moderator controls
The soundboard: play Discord's and your servers' sounds in calls
Upload a server's emoji, stickers and sounds
Community servers: create one, or turn an existing server into one
Transfer a server's ownership, or delete it, with Discord's two-factor prompt
Remove the link previews from your own messages
Search: a results panel with every filter Discord has, and autocomplete
A voice channel's own chat beside its call
Zooming an image glides into the point under the pointer
GIFs no longer sit frozen until clicked
Voting in a poll, or scrolling to the top of a channel, leaves the chat where it was
Kubecord now connects to Discord the way Chrome and Discord's website do, down to the encryption and the messages it sends
Safety limits ask before, then stop, the actions Discord's spam filter bans for: many new DMs, friend requests, server joins or profiles in a short time (they can be turned off in Settings)
Profiles are kept for a few minutes instead of fetched again on every click
Go Idle When Away: show as Idle after 10 minutes away (off by default)
The message box stays centred with two lines of text
Notes show in profiles again
Code blocks sit in a block of their own, highlighted for about 200 languages
Select text across several messages, and copy it with Ctrl+C
A draft per channel, kept across restarts
A length counter; long messages are split into several
NixOS and Home Manager modules, with declared settings and Stylix matching
A volume for each call sound
Jumping to an old message lands on it exactly and highlights it
Copying message text keeps its emoji
Files sent with no text are sent
